name: timeline
description: A vertical or horizontal timeline rendered as an ordered list. `value` is the current step: items with `step <= value` get `data-completed` (filled indicator and separator) and the current one gets `aria-current="step"`. Compose each `TimelineItem` from `TimelineHeader` (`TimelineDate`, `TimelineTitle`, `TimelineIndicator`), `TimelineSeparator` and `TimelineContent`.
